status: spec only — not executed; no browser benchmark runner exists in the repo yet
purpose: Compare dashboard caching/SSE/chart strategies for WP3.13 area optimizations. Feeds the findings in docs/spikes/wp08-consolidation.md.
constraints: No Node build step in this repo (PRD 12.1): harness is a JSON spec, to be run in headless Chrome by a future CI job or ad-hoc.
No real Docker containers, no pinned images, no real indexer/content-source traffic.
Same-origin SSE only; localhost-only wizard surface.

environment.network: throttled to ~5 Mbps down / 1 Mbps up with 80 ms RTT (simulating LAN)
environment.repeats: 7 runs per scenario, report median + p90

cache.label: localStorage
cache.notes: Tiny primitives only; synchronous, string-only, ~5 MB

cache.label: graphql-hooks key/value cache
cache.notes: Study-only: no GraphQL backend in v1; maintenance signal low

cache.label: Apollo InMemoryCache
cache.notes: Study-only: heavy, no GraphQL backend in v1

cache.label: urql document cache + graphcache + dedupExchange
cache.notes: Study-only; hold if a React dashboard is added later

sse.label: Single batched SSE endpoint + client meter
hx-trigger every 45s polling fallback
sse.notes: Used only when SSE is unavailable

chart.label: SVG DOM via Recharts
chart.notes: Good <~500 pts/series; linear DOM cost beyond

mutationQueue.label: Web Worker sql.js WASM queue
mutationQueue.notes: Post-v1; persistence via db.export() -> IndexedDB/OPFS manual

scenarios.name: Cold first paint: metrics dashboard
scenarios.slo: First contentful paint of dashboard shell < 3 s (WP3.13 theme: SSE metrics first paint)
scenarios.setup: Load dashboard HTML; inline critical SSE consumer inline; chart lib deferred with <script defer>; connect /sse/metrics; server emits heartbeat immediately.

scenarios.name: Widget state persist roundtrip
scenarios.slo: Persist + restore widget layout in < 100 ms p95
scenarios.setup: Write 50 widget preference records (layout order, collapsed, refresh interval), reload page, restore.

scenarios.name: SSE offline / reconnect replay
scenarios.slo: Reconnect within 5 s; missed events replayed and deduplicated; no duplicate widget updates
scenarios.setup: Establish stream; block network for 8 s while server emits 12 events with ids; restore network; observe Last-Event-ID replay and dedupe.

metrics.name: replayedEvents
metrics.definition: events received after reconnect with id > checkpoint

metrics.name: duplicateApplications
metrics.definition: widget refreshes for already-applied event ids (must be 0)

scenarios.name: Metrics line chart render cost
scenarios.slo: < 16 ms frame budget per update (60 fps) at 1 k points/series
scenarios.setup: Render 4 widgets each with a line chart at 1 k / 10 k / 100 k points; trigger one update per second for 30 s.

metrics.name: memoryGrowthMB
metrics.definition: heap delta after 30 updates (performance.memory if available)

scenarios.name: SSE throughput under metering
scenarios.slo: Client applies <= 5 events/widget/sec; coalesced updates never exceed 1 per widget per 250 ms
scenarios.setup: Server floods 100 events/sec across 20 widgets for 10 s; count applied widget refreshes.

metrics.name: pollRequestsPerMinute
metrics.definition: fallback polling request rate (should be < 2/min per widget)

instrumentation.logging: One JSON line per run per metric; no request bodies, no API keys, no tokens.

openItems: Add a browser benchmark runner (Playwright/Puppeteer implied — would add a Node dependency; conflicts with PRD 12.1 'No Node build step' unless confined to CI tooling outside the repo binary). Decide where benchmark code lives before executing.
Confirm POR timing instrumentation definition before adding API timing scenarios.
Verify IndexedDB quota/behavior on target browsers (headless Chrome vs real user profiles).
